title: The CARESSES Randomised Controlled Trial: Exploring the Health-Related Impact of Culturally Competent Artificial Intelligence Embedded Into Socially Assistive Robots and Tested in Older Adult Care Hom
summary: A randomized study evaluated a culturally competent AI socially assistive robot intervention in older-adult care. It reports a narrow emotional-wellbeing outcome and no physical-health effect; small completer groups limit inference.
ai_technology: Methods and Results describe the England/Japan randomized study, three arms and 33 completers; SF-36 Emotional Wellbeing improved versus care-as-usual, while physical-health effects were not found.
